notes.file: file is relative to this manifest
notes.compatibleMetadata: sorting, quality, alphaValues, attachX, attachY, states and new are extra fields carried from Art03/index.json so a sidecar can keep the original clip contract
notes.attach: attachX/attachY are the art03 arrays unchanged: one point per frame, x right and y DOWN from the top-left pixel of the 64x64 cell (not the bottom-left pivot space), the leading-edge point at radius 29.5 from the cell centre, drawn facing +X. On the edge sheet that pixel is opaque on frames 0-2; frame 3 of the edge sheet is empty as in art03.
notes.trailAlpha: art03 trail alphaValues were [0,112,176]; this trail is [0,46,76] (max 29.8%). A sidecar that keeps the art03 alphaValues for this ID would fail an alpha-membership check.
notes.heldAndIcon: wpn_jawbone-club_held_32 and ico_wpn_jawbone-club_static_16 are not in this bundle; the approved art-jawbone-feedback-01 v2 files are reused unchanged.
